_about: Generic Spells that fetch a card by its Type, Level or kind, not by name or archetype. scripts/build-small-world-scores.js tries each one in every test deck (how much it adds to the chance of opening a starter, at the copies the TCG banlist allows) and counts one already in a list only when it can reach a starter; assets/js/card-browser.js shows the results and, for any card, which of these can fetch it. target: monster (true), race (the monster Type), attribute, level (exact), levelMax, levelMin, frame ('Normal' or 'Ritual'), spell ('Field'). New entries come from the admin page (Generic Searchers): scripts/find-generic-searchers.js copies approved ones in and removes rejected ones every week. verb: add (to the hand), summon (Special Summon), excavate (Pot of Prosperity: the top cards of the Deck). cost 'monster': needs another monster in hand to send. passcode: for the card art.

searchers.name: Reinforcement of the Army
searchers.note: Adds a Level 4 or lower Warrior from the Deck.

searchers.name: Fire Formation - Tenki
searchers.note: When activated, adds a Level 4 or lower Beast-Warrior from the Deck.

searchers.name: Bonfire
searchers.note: Adds a Level 4 or lower Pyro from the Deck.

searchers.name: Fossil Dig
searchers.note: Adds a Level 6 or lower Dinosaur from the Deck.

searchers.name: Cynet Mining
searchers.note: Sends a card from your hand to the GY, then adds a Level 4 or lower Cyberse from the Deck.

searchers.name: Preparation of Rites
searchers.note: Adds a Level 7 or lower Ritual Monster from the Deck, then can add a Ritual Spell from the GY.

searchers.name: Emergency Teleport
searchers.note: Special Summons a Level 3 or lower Psychic from the hand or Deck; it's banished in the End Phase.

searchers.name: One for One
searchers.note: Sends a monster from your hand to the GY, then Special Summons a Level 1 monster from the hand or Deck.

searchers.name: Unexpected Dai
searchers.note: If you control no monsters, Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from the Deck.

searchers.name: Terraforming
searchers.note: Adds a Field Spell from the Deck.

searchers.name: Pot of Prosperity
searchers.note: Banishes 3 or 6 cards from your Extra Deck face-down, excavates as many from the top of the Deck and adds 1.
